messages:
nina: Quick q for people headed to Munich 11EA1FA
Anyone bringing noise-cancelling headphones or relying on airport naps?

ash: Definitely ANC. Also bring foam earplugs for the plane and a small eye mask.

devon: Window seat for red-eyes = sleep win. Aisle is for bathroom runs.

karen: Middle seat = nightmare. PSA: check in 24h early and use the airline app to try seat swaps.

flights-bot: Tip: Set a seat alert and check seatmaps 24 hours before departure for upgrades.

nina: Overhead bin drama4E6622
Is pre-boarding worth queuing to secure space?

ash: Not usually. Bring a slim backpack and a small collapsible tote for extras.

devon: Pro tip: keep one "in-flight outfit" in your personal item (leggings + hoodie). makes arrivals easier.

karen: Lounge question: Amex Platinum vs Priority Pass + pay-entry 4B33E0 Anyone have a favorite for EU travel?

nina: Amex Plat has better lounges overall but double-check guest rules. Priority Pass got weird in 2022 for some lounges.

ash: Bring a multi-port USB-C charger with PD. Fewer bricks, faster charges.

devon: Pack a micro-fiber towel and dental floss. odd, but saved me after a 20h layover.

karen: Mini poll 44D44E
Pre-flight coffee at SFO 9:00am by Gate A12?

nina: +1

ash: +1

devon: -1 (red-eye arrival)

flights-bot: Poll created: "Pre-flight coffee 9:00am Gate A12". Results so far: 2 yes, 1 no.

nina: Lovely. I'll try to snag a table near A12 and drop a note in the dinner thread. See y'all!
